title: Exploiting Concavity Information in Gaussian Process Contextual Bandit Optimization
abstract: arXiv:2503.10836v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: The contextual bandit models sequential decision-making problems in which rewards depend on both the chosen action and observed context. In many domains such as medicine, business, and engineering, prior knowledge provides structural information about the reward function that can be exploited to improve optimization efficiency. This paper studies settings where, for each observable context, the conditional mean reward is known to be concave with respect to the action variable. To leverage this structure, we develop a contextual bandit algorithm that conditions a Bayesian Gaussian Process posterior on concavity constraints. We propose a novel reward model that combines a concavity-preserving regression spline basis with a constrained GP posterior, yielding a tractable shape-constrained estimator. Building on this model, we construct a UCB algorithm and establish new posterior concentration inequalities for the constrained poster

translated_title: 在高斯过程上下文老虎机优化中利用凹性信息
translated_abstract: 上下文老虎机对序贯决策问题进行建模，其中奖励同时取决于所选动作和观测到的上下文。在医学、商业和工程等许多领域中，先验知识提供了关于奖励函数的结构信息，可以利用这些信息来提高优化效率。本文研究这样一种设置：对于每个可观测的上下文，条件平均奖励已知关于动作变量是凹的。为了利用这一结构，我们开发了一种上下文老虎机算法，该算法在凹性约束条件下对贝叶斯高斯过程后验进行条件化。我们提出了一种新颖的奖励模型，将保持凹性的回归样条基与受约束的高斯过程后验相结合，得到一个易于处理的形状约束估计器。基于该模型，我们构建了UCB算法，并为受约束后验建立了新的后验集中不等式。
tldr: 本文提出一种将保持凹性的回归样条基与受凹性约束的高斯过程后验相结合的新型奖励模型，并据此构建UCB算法，从而在上下文老虎机优化中利用已知的凹性结构提升序贯决策的优化效率。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a novel reward model that combines concavity-preserving regression spline bases with concavity-constrained Gaussian Process posteriors, and builds a UCB algorithm upon it to exploit known concavity structure for more efficient sequential decision-making in contextual bandit optimization.
